final: WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT o.mktnote AS trading_pair, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS average_difference FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink GROUP BY o.mktnote), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_difference) AS value FROM pair_averages) SELECT AVG(p.average_difference) AS average_above_baseline, AVG(p.average_difference - a.value) AS average_excess FROM pair_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall_average AS a WHERE a.value IS NOT NULL AND p.average_difference > a.value
